integrity: The mathematical proof states definitions and boundary cases. The included standalone verifier tests direct enumeration and independently constructed four-state transfer matrices. The review is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one Rule-110 update on indexed cyclic binary rings; not to deeper preimages, aperiodic configurations, or stochastic dynamics. The Perrin homogeneous count and de Bruijn technique are background. An inaccessible historical article/thesis may contain an implicit comparable comparison.
title: Sharp cyclic inverse-branching bound for elementary Rule 110
